script.text: With one victory each, the next winner would own You Show Duel School. Since Gong wasn't a You Show student, it was up to You Show's newest student, Sora.
The name's Kit Blade! And I'm the slickest Synchro Summoner you'll ever meet! Now which one of you do I get to beat?
Gong wishes Gong could get in there, but since Gong doesn't go to You Show, Gong can't step up to take down the competition.
Listen, Sora. This is a win-or-go-home situation, so you gotta beat him!
I'm not really into pressure situations like this. I'm sure the competition won't mind, so if you wanna duel instead of me, I'm totally fine with it, big brows.
I don't have all day, big brows. If you're chicken, save us both some time and get someone else to duel! Y' got it?
How dare you! Gong'll show you who's chicken!
The winner takes it all… and the loser loses all!
